description: baseline: LightGBM binary classifier with 5-fold stratified CV (N=891 << 10k threshold), feature engineering (Title from Name, Deck from Cabin, FamilySize/IsAlone, log-Fare, Age missingness indicator), median/mode imputation, and native LightGBM categorical handling
Enhanced feature engineering (TicketPrefix, IsChild, AgeBin, Fare_per_person, Sex_Pclass interaction, IsMother, FamilySizeGroup) + LightGBM+XGBoost ensemble with tuned hyperparameters

Switch to CatBoost with 5-fold OOF evaluation (all 891 samples) + Sex_Pclass interaction feature; CatBoost's ordered boosting excels at small datasets with categorical features, and OOF gives a more stable metric than the single 20% hold-out
Optuna HPO (50 trials) to find optimal CatBoost hyperparameters + add TicketGroup size, FarePerPerson, and WomanOrChild features to CatBoost with 5-fold OOF

3-model ensemble (CatBoost + LightGBM + XGBoost) each with Optuna HPO, plus richer feature engineering (FamilySizeGroup, IsChild, AgeBin, IsMother, SurnameGroup, NumCabins) and Optuna-optimized blend weights over OOF predictions

Added ExtraTrees as 4th diverse base model (bagging vs. boosting), 7 new features (DeckNum ordinal, CabinNum, HasTicketPrefix, NameLength, Fare_class_z within-Pclass, Title_Pclass interaction, Pclass_Embarked interaction), and 2-level stacking with a cross-validated Logistic Regression meta-learner on the 4 OOF prediction arrays

Multi-seed ensemble (5 seeds for CatBoost, 3 for LGB/XGB) to reduce variance from random splits + 3 new interaction features (IsAlone×Pclass, WomanOrChild×Pclass, FamilySize×Pclass) + increased CatBoost HPO to 60 trials; seed-averaging stabilizes OOF predictions on this small N=891 dataset

Title-based Age imputation, K-fold target encoding for categoricals (benefits LGB/XGB), new features (TicketPrefix, Fare_class_z, Age_Pclass), and 3-fold-seed × 5-model-seed final training for smoother OOF estimates

Added OOF family/ticket group survival rate features (Surname_survival_oof, Ticket_survival_oof) to capture Titanic's "families survive together" signal, plus RandomForest as a 4th diverse base model (bagging vs boosting) with Optuna HPO and multi-seed training

Added Bayesian smoothing to OOF group survival features (reduces small-group noise), new SurnameTicket_survival_oof feature (captures most specific family unit), CabinNumber extraction, and HistGradientBoosting as 5th ensemble model with Optuna HPO for additional diversity

Added SVM (RBF kernel) as 6th diverse base model with Optuna HPO + proper fold-level scaling, expanded CB to 7 model seeds and LGB to 4 seeds, and updated 6-model blend optimization with 400 Optuna trials for better weight discovery

Fix SyntaxError from exp 10, add SVM (RBF kernel) as 6th diverse base model with proper per-fold StandardScaler, expand CB to 7 seeds and LGB to 4 seeds for better variance reduction, add 3 new interaction features (MaleAdult, FemaleHighClass, Child_Pclass), and expand blend optimization to 400 trials over 6 models

Add MLP (sklearn MLPClassifier, 20 Optuna HPO trials, 3×3 seed averaging) and Logistic Regression (10 HPO trials, 3 fold seeds) as 7th and 8th diverse ensemble models — neural net and linear model add different inductive bias vs all tree-based models, with 8-model Optuna blend optimization (400 trials)

Fix SyntaxError from exp 12 (Unicode × char + truncated file), add MLP (7th model, 15 HPO trials, early_stopping) and LogisticRegression (8th model, 10 HPO trials) as diverse ensemble members, add rank-averaging blend variant, add Title_Pclass + FareLog_Sex + DeckOrd features, and update to 8-model Optuna blend optimization (400 trials)

Added 2 new OOF group survival features (Deck_survival_oof, TitlePclass_survival_oof) + FareLog_Female interaction, and a level-2 CatBoost meta-learner stacking on 6 base model OOF predictions with rank-normalized features to capture non-linear ensemble patterns

Restore from best_train.py (exp 11, 0.908403) and add ExtraTrees as 7th diverse ensemble model (random thresholds differ from RF) + SexAgeBin_survival_oof feature (10 well-populated sex×age groups capturing fine-grained Titanic survival patterns), with 7-model Optuna blend optimization (500 trials)

Restore from best_train.py (exp 11, 0.908403), add SexPclass_survival_oof and WocPclass_survival_oof features (6-group OOF rates for the most discriminative Titanic groupings), and replace Optuna blend with scipy Powell multi-start (300 Dirichlet-initialized starts) which is far more efficient for smooth 6D continuous optimization, plus add rank-average blend and Optuna blend as additional candidates

Restore from best_train.py (exp 11), add rsm (random subspace method, 0.5-1.0) to CatBoost HPO to tune feature column sampling, increase CB HPO trials 60→80, and expand CB model seeds 7→10 for more stable OOF estimates

Restored from best_train.py (exp 11, 0.908403), added multi-seed OOF survival features (avg of 3 CV seeds for smoother surname/ticket/surname+ticket survival estimates), CabinParity feature (odd/even cabin number for port/starboard side), and LightGBM DART boosting seeds (2 seeds mixed into LGB ensemble for dropout-based regularization diversity), plus rank-average blend as additional candidate

Restored from best_train.py (exp 11, 0.908403) and added K-Nearest Neighbors as 7th diverse ensemble model (Optuna HPO over n_neighbors/weights/metric, 3-fold-seed OOF averaging) — distance-based inductive bias is fundamentally different from all tree/kernel models, with 7-model Optuna blend optimization (500 trials)
